verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਨ ਚੰਚਲ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jal mil bahu baran banaasapatee cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh ban cha(n)chal karat hai ||

en.bdb: Water gives rise to a variety of vegetation, but sandalwood conducts its fragrance to the whole forest. (Similarly, worshipping fake gods leads to rebirth into various life forms but the True Guru, like sandalwood, unites a Sikh with One True Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਜੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਖੀਅਤਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਧਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise agan agan dhaat joiee soiee dhekheeat paaras paras jot ka(n)chan dharat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a metal shines like fire when placed in it, but in reality it is no different than what it is. But with a touch of philosopher stone, the same metal becomes gold and shines like it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਮਿਟਤ ਨਹੀ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਭੈਜਲ ਤਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: taise aan dhev sev miTat nahee kuTev satigur dhev sev bhaijal tarat hai ||

en.bdb: Similarly the service of other gods and goddesses cannot destroy the dross of ego of many births. But successful service of the reffulgent True Guru sails one across the worldly ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਉਚਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੯॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal mahaatam agaadh bodh net net net namo namo ucharat hai ||489||

en.bdb: Significance and the ecstasy of True Guru blessed Naam Simran is beyond explanation. That is why all supplicate and salute Him saying repeatedly-Not this, Not this and Not even this.  (489)
